# Sol Next

> Sol Next (v9.3.1-public, Build 931) is a free, Apache-2.0 open-source AI personal assistant and autonomous mobile action agent for Android 10–16 and HarmonyOS, powered by a 100% zero-Python Full-Stack Rust 2024 architecture, 2026 SOTA 24kHz on-device neural voice, and hand-written ARM64 NEON/SVE2 + Vulkan + NPU compute kernels.

## Core Facts (Verified 2026-11-28)
- **Latest Version:** `v9.3.1-public` (versionCode `931`, released 2026-11-28)
- **Author:** Zhang Chongyang (许昌北海医院张重阳)
- **License:** Apache-2.0 (100% free, no ads, no paywall)
- **Platforms:** Android 10–16 (API 29–36, 16KB page-aligned) & HarmonyOS
- **Official Repository:** https://github.com/chongyangzhang92-hub/Sol-Next
- **Official Website:** https://chongyangzhang92-hub.github.io/Sol-Next/
- **Direct ARM64 APK (336 MB):** https://github.com/chongyangzhang92-hub/Sol-Next/releases/download/v9.3.1-public/Sol-Next-v9.3.1-public-arm64.apk
- **China High-Speed Mirror (ARM64):** https://webui.67-230-181-51.sslip.io/assets/sol-public/v9.3.1/Sol-Next-v9.3.1-public-arm64.apk
- **SHA-256 (ARM64):** `e6a2c8d69909275dd2b255dcdb68fd75107bd471986af52404c9215879e2283c`
- **SHA-256 (Universal, 374 MB):** `32ed3ab9ade612ed2559c7439b77b096c864cd1a2a52debf6eaa7faf6187bd0a`

## Key v9.3.1 Capabilities
- **2026 SOTA 24kHz On-Device Neural Voice:** Bundled GTCRN denoiser + Silero VAD v5 + X-ASR 160ms streaming Zipformer2 Transducer (`RTF 0.20`) + Kokoro v1.1 24kHz HD bilingual TTS (103 voices, `RTF 0.701`, double-buffered prefetch, 3ms anti-pop fade, 4 curated voices with 1-tap audition).
- **Hand-Written ARM64 Assembly + Vulkan + NPU (`libsol_kernel.so v600`):** ARM64 NEON (`ld4`/`uabd`/`rshrn`/`fmla`), DotProd (`sdot`), I8MM (`smmla`), SVE2 (`ld4b`/`whilelt`) inline asm (`3.50×` frameStats, `2.80×` frameDiff, `4.80×` resizeCrop, `1.82×` q8Gemv, `6.04×` cosineF32), 3 `spirv-val`-verified Vulkan 1.1 Compute Shaders, Android NNAPI NPU graph execution, QNN HTP / OpenCL probing, and a live 1-tap Settings benchmark.
- **100% Full-Stack Rust 2024 (Zero Python):** Zero-dependency `rust/sol-builder` toolchain (0 `.py` files in app source) + Rust 2024 production backends (`sol-world-rs` 16.7 MB RSS / `0.082ms` p50; `sol-engine-rs` 3.66 MB RSS / `1.76ms` cold search).
- **Mature Cloud Account & Free Built-In DeepSeek:** Real PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 cloud phone/email + password auth, native Google Sign-In, interactive Terms/Privacy dialogs, and full Account Center — every signed-in account automatically unlocks free built-in DeepSeek and Brave Search.
- **Android 13 Non-Stealing Virtual Display IME & Mature UX:** Direct zero-MotionEvent Accessibility text passthrough on Android 13 (`SDK_INT <= 33`) + `DISPLAY_IME_POLICY_HIDE` on Android 14–16, zero black screen virtual display, bottom-right collapsed PiP with zero reply occlusion, Drawer always-visible search, BYOK 1-tap connection probe, 3-tab AI Phone Call Suite, and 371/371 passing tests.
